newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev falls to 2,000 per dollar at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev falls to 2,000 per dollar at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev weakened to 1,930-2,000 per dollar in thin interbank volume at the close from the morning's 1,850-1,960 as foreign currency supply waned, dealers said.
"Banks and clients were bidding for relatively light dollar volumes but supply was almost nonexistent and the lev lost some 30 percent from yesterday as a result," one dealer said.
The lev closed around 1,530-1,590 per dollar on Thursday, down from 935-950 at the beginning of the week. It traded near 600 a month ago.
Dealers said they expected the lev to continue its rapid decline next week if there was no solution to the current political deadlock. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
